name: klaviyo-revenue-share-of-shopify-sales
description: Use for "how much of our store revenue comes from Klaviyo", "what share of Shopify sales is email and SMS", "is our Klaviyo pulling its weight", "flows vs campaigns revenue for our store", "what percent of store revenue is retention marketing", or "is email revenue going up as a share of the store" — even when the user never says "contribution". Use when the decision is whether email and SMS earn their place and whether effort goes to flows or campaigns. Needs Klaviyo and the store's Shopify data.
